question: The effect of vomiting on seeing Echidna; is that a mana sickness sort of thing? Also, would normal people also vomit on seeing Professor Echidna?
answer: They wouldn't vomit for Professor Echidna. Vomiting on seeing Echidna is an instinctive sort of thing. Basically it's a sanity point check. (note: Call of Cthulhu game reference)
